description.en:
Basic Attack

Perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.

Heavy Attack

Perform a charged attack at the cost of STA, dealing Electro DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Perform a Plunging Attack from mid-air at the cost of STA, dealing Electro DMG.

Dodge Counter

Use Basic Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Melakukan hingga 5 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Electro DMG.

Heavy Attack

Melakukan serangan terisi dengan biaya STA, memberikan Electro DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Melakukan Plunging Attack dari udara dengan biaya STA, memberikan Electro DMG.

Dodge Counter

Gunakan Basic Attack setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Electro DMG.

description.en: Attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.

Attack the target, dealing Electro DMG. Enter Intuition.
When in Intuition:
-Obtain 3 Hypercube(s). Each time Resonance Skill Law of Reigns is cast, consume 1 Hypercube(s). Intuition ends once all Hypercubes are consumed.
-Basic Attack and Heavy Attack are replaced with Basic Attack Pivot - Impale, which performs up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.
-Resonance Skill Deduction is replaced with Resonance Skill Divergence, which deals Electro DMG.
-Dodge Counter is replaced with Dodge Counter Unfathomed, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.
description.id:
Menyerang target, memberikan Electro DMG. Memasuki Intuition.
Saat dalam Intuition:
-Mendapat 3 Hypercube. Setiap kali Resonance Skill Law of Reigns dilancarkan, konsumsi 1 Hypercube. Intuition berakhir setelah semua Hypercube dikonsumsi.
-Basic Attack dan Heavy Attack digantikan oleh Basic Attack Pivot - Impale, yang melakukan hingga 3 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Electro DMG.
-Resonance Skill Deduction digantikan oleh Resonance Skill Divergence, yang memberikan Electro DMG.
-Dodge Counter digantikan oleh Dodge Counter Unfathomed, dianggap sebagai Resonance Liberation DMG.

description.en: Gain 5% Electro DMG Bonus after casting Resonance Skill for 8s, stackable for up to 4 times.
description.id: Mendapat 5% Electro DMG Bonus setelah melancarkan Resonance Skill selama 8 dtk, dapat ditumpuk hingga 4 kali.

description.en: When in Intuition triggered by Resonance Liberation, Xiangli Yao's resistance to interruption is enhanced.
description.id: Saat dalam Intuition yang dipicu oleh Resonance Liberation, ketahanan Xiangli Yao terhadap interupsi meningkat.

description.en: Attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.

Resonance Skill - Decipher

When Capacity reaches 100, Resonance Skill Deduction is replaced by Resonance Skill Decipher.
Consume 100 Capacity to cast Resonance Skill Decipher, dealing Electro DMG, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.

Resonance Skill - Law of Reigns

When Performance Capacity reaches 5 in Intuition state, Resonance Skill Divergence is replaced by Resonance Skill Law of Reigns.
Consume 5 Performance Capacity to cast Resonance Skill Law of Reigns, dealing Electro DMG, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.

Mid-air Attack - Revamp

Shortly after casting Resonance Skill Decipher or Resonance Skill Divergence, use Basic Attack to perform Mid-air Attack Revamp at the cost of STA, dealing Electro DMG, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.

Capacity

Xiangli Yao can hold up to 100 Capacity.
Every Normal Attack Probe on hit grants Capacity.
Every Resonance Skill Deduction on hit grants Capacity.

Performance Capacity

Xiangli Yao can hold up to 5 Performance Capacity.
When in Intuition triggered by Resonance Liberation:
Obtain 1 Performance Capacity when Stage 1 of Basic Attack Pivot - Impale hits a target.
Obtain 2 Performance Capacity when Stage 2 or 3 of Basic Attack Pivot - Impale hits a target.
Obtain 2 Performance Capacity for every Resonance Skill Divergence on hit.
Obtain 3 Performance Capacity for every Mid-air Attack Revamp on hit.
Obtain 2 Performance Capacity for every Dodge Counter Unfathomed on hit.
description.id:
Resonance Skill - Decipher

Saat Capacity mencapai 100, Resonance Skill Deduction digantikan oleh Resonance Skill Decipher.
Konsumsi 100 Capacity untuk melancarkan Resonance Skill Decipher, memberikan Electro DMG, dianggap sebagai Resonance Liberation DMG.

Resonance Skill - Law of Reigns

Saat Performance Capacity mencapai 5 dalam status Intuition, Resonance Skill Divergence digantikan oleh Resonance Skill Law of Reigns.
Konsumsi 5 Performance Capacity untuk melancarkan Resonance Skill Law of Reigns, memberikan Electro DMG, dianggap sebagai Resonance Liberation DMG.

Mid-air Attack - Revamp

Sesaat setelah melancarkan Resonance Skill Decipher atau Resonance Skill Divergence, gunakan Basic Attack untuk melakukan Mid-air Attack Revamp dengan biaya STA, memberikan Electro DMG, dianggap sebagai Resonance Liberation DMG.

Capacity

Xiangli Yao dapat menampung hingga 100 Capacity.
Setiap Normal Attack Probe yang mengenai target memberikan Capacity.
Setiap Resonance Skill Deduction yang mengenai target memberikan Capacity.

Performance Capacity

Xiangli Yao dapat menampung hingga 5 Performance Capacity.
Saat dalam Intuition yang dipicu oleh Resonance Liberation:
Mendapat 1 Performance Capacity saat Tahap 1 Basic Attack Pivot - Impale mengenai target.
Mendapat 2 Performance Capacity saat Tahap 2 atau 3 Basic Attack Pivot - Impale mengenai target.
Mendapat 2 Performance Capacity setiap kali Resonance Skill Divergence mengenai target.
Mendapat 3 Performance Capacity setiap kali Mid-air Attack Revamp mengenai target.
Mendapat 2 Performance Capacity setiap kali Dodge Counter Unfathomed mengenai target.

description.en: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.
description.id: Berpeluang menghasilkan hidangan spesial saat memasak.

description.en: Xiangli Yao will call down a laser beam upon the first target the incoming Resonator's Basic Attack hits, dealing Electro DMG equal to 237.63% of Xiangli Yao's ATK to an area. This effect lasts for 8s and can be triggered once every 2s, up to 3 times.
description.id: Xiangli Yao akan menjatuhkan sinar laser pada target pertama yang terkena Basic Attack Resonator yang masuk, memberikan Electro DMG sebesar 237,63% ATK Xiangli Yao ke suatu area. Efek ini berlangsung selama 8 dtk dan dapat dipicu sekali setiap 2 dtk, hingga 3 kali.

description.en: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
description.id: Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melancarkan Tune Break pada target.

description.en: Resonance Skill Law of Reigns additionally launches 6 Convolution Matrices at enemies, each dealing Resonance Liberation DMG equal to 8% of the skill's DMG Multiplier.
description.id: Resonance Skill Law of Reigns juga meluncurkan 6 Convolution Matrices ke musuh, masing-masing memberikan Resonance Liberation DMG sebesar 8% Pengali DMG skill tersebut.

description.en: Casting Resonance Skill or Resonance Liberation Cogitation Model increases Crit. DMG by 30% for 8s.
description.id: Melancarkan Resonance Skill atau Resonance Liberation Cogitation Model meningkatkan Crit. DMG sebesar 30% selama 8 dtk.

description.en:
Casting Resonance Liberation Cogitation Model increases the DMG of the following Resonance Skill moves by 63% for 24s:
Decipher, Deduction, Divergence, and Law of Reigns.
This effect can be triggered up to 5 times.
description.id:
Melancarkan Resonance Liberation Cogitation Model meningkatkan DMG gerakan Resonance Skill berikut sebesar 63% selama 24 dtk:
Decipher, Deduction, Divergence, dan Law of Reigns.
Efek ini dapat dipicu hingga 5 kali.

description.en: Casting Resonance Liberation Cogitation Model grants a 25% DMG Bonus to all team members' Resonance Liberation for 30s.
description.id: Melancarkan Resonance Liberation Cogitation Model memberikan 25% DMG Bonus pada Resonance Liberation seluruh anggota tim selama 30 dtk.

description.en: The DMG Multiplier of Outro Skill Chain Rule is increased by 222%. The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation Cogitation Model is increased by 100%.
description.id: Pengali DMG Outro Skill Chain Rule meningkat sebesar 222%. Pengali DMG Resonance Liberation Cogitation Model meningkat sebesar 100%.

description.en: The Hypercubes obtained from Resonance Liberation Cogitation Model are enhanced, increasing the DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill Law of Reigns by 76%.
description.id: Hypercube yang didapat dari Resonance Liberation Cogitation Model diperkuat, meningkatkan Pengali DMG Resonance Skill Law of Reigns sebesar 76%.
